Title: Gen*Con Indy Lost and Found department

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ben Peal tells me that there was a plush doll left behind at the
North American Championships this past weekend. It is now found and
looking for its owner. If you're missing one, please email me
privately (not on the newsgroup) and identify the doll so that we
can work out some way of returning it to you...
